purpose.summary: Maps stability basins; scores capacity (C), Saturation Index (SI), and depletion rate (DR); primary engine of the Substrate Overlay.
purpose.detail: The SBC receives the Structural Frame, Drift Report, and Coherence Report from the S3 Spine bus and identifies stability basins — regions of the structural frame capable of sustaining active regimes. For each basin, the SBC scores: Capacity (C, total load the basin can absorb), Saturation Index (SI = current load / C), Depletion Rate (DR = rate of SI increase), and Runway (R = estimated time to SI = 1.0 at current DR). SBC also validates the Structural Faultline Detector's fault scores against basin load data and feeds substrate readings to the Crystal Mycelial Engine for network flow analysis.
